transcriber_notes: SnowPilot hardness-only chart: grain table columns present but empty. Boundaries measured on the height axis in pixels (5.03 px/cm, +-0.5 cm) and agree with printed layer notes/tests (118, 95, 77, 55, 45); 85 and 25 cm from axis only. Hardness bars grow leftward; class ticks every 72 px with minor ticks at thirds; bar ends at a first-third tick read as +/- (95-85 and 25-0 one third past 4F toward 1F = 4F+; 77-55 one third short of P = P-).
